episode_title: Trump's Push To Reinstate Huang, Market Reacts To Nvidia, Russia-Ukraine War Widening
script_en: Trump's Push To Reinstate Huang, Market Reacts To Nvidia, Russia-Ukraine War Widening.
President Trump says he pushed Nvidia to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO, raising questions about why the White House is getting involved in who runs a private company.
Nvidia gained nearly a trillion dollars in value after Huang returned, showing how much of the A-I economy is tied to one company and one man.
Russia’s war in Ukraine is spreading far beyond the battlefield, even as the Trump administration says talks toward a peace deal are making progress.
